Hi Alex — great, we’ll lock in Tue Nov 16 at 14:00 PT. Calendar invite will follow. Quick answers to your prep questions so you can assign owners: 

1) Log retention: for the intake we usually request a 7-day contiguous sample window (full logs) plus daily 1-in-100 sampled events for the preceding 90 days. If exporting full 90-day logs is easier for your ops team we can accept that instead — let us know which is simplest.

2) KMS: AWS KMS BYOK is acceptable and common. For CAIQ we document key management controls; an HSM attestation is only required if you surface dedicated HSM usage in your architecture or the procurement team requests it. Please flag if your KMS usage includes imported keys or multi-region replication so we can map controls correctly.

3) Artifact format: prefer zipped logs (gzip) for large exports and PDF for policy docs / configuration screenshots. For ACLs and IAM configs a CSV or JSON manifest is fine.

Action items for the precall (I’ll circulate a tracker after invite):
• NorthArc: assign primary artifact owner for logs and policy docs (Alex / Roberto?)
• Redwood: send a short evidence checklist (Irene) and confirm expected retention/sample props
• Both: confirm secure transfer mechanism (S3 presigned link vs secure ShareDrive)

Irene — I attached our CAIQ export above. Can you prepare the short checklist and a suggested minimal evidence set (PDF) we can share before the call? Marissa / Ben — FYI on scheduling and potential follow-ups (procurement redlines).

Thanks — looking forward to the call.
Dylan
